uab: mab (mab) — son; noun m., soft-mutated after a personal name in a patronymic (Guawl uab Clut 'Gwawl son of Clud') · also soft after predicative yn (yn uab y wr arall 'a son of another man'; yn uab y Pwyll 'a son of Pwyll')
a: a — (1) preverbal/relative particle before a verb, causes soft mutation (Pwyll … a oed; ef a welei); (2) 'and' before a consonant, spirant mutation (a chanu, a fob); (3) 'with' (a'y gydymdeithon; gyt a thi); (4) vocative particle (A unben); (5) 'whoever, what' before a verb (a del 'whoever may come'; a wnaethost 'what you did') · (6) 3 sg. present of mynet 'goes' (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there'; yd a hitheu 'she goes'); (7) interrogative particle before a verb (a oes …? 'is there …?'; a dywedy di …? 'will you tell …?'); (8) in a'y kymriw neu archolleu the editorial a'y stands for the conjunction ae 'either' (ae … neu 'either … or'; the Red Book has ae kymriw ae archolleu): read the two halves together as ae · (9) 'as' after an equative (kyn debycket a'r mab 'as like as the boy'; kyn ureisket oed a mab chweblwyd 'as stout as a boy of six')
oed: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect 'was' (Pwyll... a oed yn arglwyd) · also oed 'appointed time, tryst', noun m., = oet (gwna oed a mi 'make an appointment with me')
urenhin: brenhin (brenin) — king; noun m., soft-mutated (in apposition or as object): Hafgan urenhin, y deu urenhin
ar: ar — (1) preposition 'on, upon; at' (ar Hafgan; ar y carw; ar y gilyd 'against the other'); (2) the article yr after a vowel, 'that which' (noc ar a uu 'than what was'; Ar ny del 'and whoever does not come') · also (3) 'with, accompanied by' (ar y ganuet marchauc 'with his hundred horsemen'); 'in' (ar y ssynnwyr e hun 'in his own senses'; ar perued y digrifwch 'in the middle of the merriment'); ar neill law Pwyll 'on one side of Pwyll'; ar uyrr 'quickly'; ar hynny 'thereupon' (see yny)
yr: yr — (1) the article 'the' before a vowel (yr erchwys); (2) 'for, for the sake of' preposition (yr Duw 'for God's sake', yr guaret gormes 'for removing the oppression') · (3) 'for all, however' before an equative-type noun and a clause (yr araued y kerdei y uarch 'for all the slowness with which his horse went'); (4) in yr meityn 'for a while (since)'; (5) the verbal particle y, yd, written yr before a vowel (yr ymordiwedei a hi 'that he would overtake her')
ynys: ynys (ynys) — island; noun f. (yr ynys hon 'this island'); no mutation
hon: hon (hon) — 'this' (f.); demonstrative (yn y lle hon 'in this place', lle treated as feminine)
ac: a — 'and' before a vowel (ac ef); also the preposition a 'with' before a vowel (ymgael ac ef 'meet with him', ymordiwes ac ef) · the manuscript also writes ac before some consonants (Ac wal, Ac val, ac racdaw) · also 'as' after an equative or kymeint (kymeint ac ynot ti 'as much as in you'; mor anwedus ac ar y wnaethoed 'as unseemly as what she had done')
o: o (o) — (1) 'of, from' preposition; (2) 'if' before a verb (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also 'on, by' (o pedestric 'on foot'), 'out of, from' (o'th garyat ti 'from love of you'), 'of' a kind (pryt … o uorwyn 'the looks of (any) maiden') · also agent after a verbal noun, 'by' (troi o Pwyll y got 'Pwyll turning the bag'); o gosp 'of punishment'
yd: yd — preverbal particle used when the clause opens with an adverb rather than the subject, introducing an indicative main verb (A threigylgweith yd oed yn Arberth)
yn: yn — (1) 'in' (yn Arberth; nasal mutation: yn nyblyc); (2) predicative 'as' with soft mutation (yn wisc hela, yn arglwyd); (3) with a verbal noun, progressive (yn dyuot 'coming'); (4) before an adjective, adverbial (yn llawen 'gladly') · (5) yn yd 'to where' (ymchwelut yn yd oed Pwyll 'returning to where Pwyll was')
llys: llys (llys) — court; noun f., base form
idaw: idaw (iddo) — to him; 3 sg. m. conjugated form of y 'to'
eisted: eisted (eistedd) — to sit; verbal noun (eisted a wnaethant 'they sat')
oedynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. imperfect 'they were' (nit oedynt unllef)
uch: uch (uwch) — above, over; preposition (uch llaw y llys 'above the court')
penn: penn (pen) — head, end; noun m., base form (Penn Annwuyn 'Head of Annwfn')
y: y — (1) the article 'the' (y llys); (2) 'his, her, its' (y uryt: soft mutation = his; y hymdidan: h-prefix = her); (3) 'to' (y hela, y gyuoeth); (4) preverbal particle after a fronted adverb or object (yno y bu, Pwyll... a oed); (5) the relative in oblique relations (o'r a welsei) · (6) 'from' in y gan, y wrth 'from, compared with' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'; y wrth y ffryt hi 'compared with her form'); (7) infixed object 'him, her, it' after a (a'y guelei 'who saw her'); (8) in a'y kymriw it is the second letter of ae 'either' (see a) · also (9) y am, y amdanaw 'from about, off' (y amdanaw 'off him'); y am hynny 'around that, beyond that, besides' · also (10) 'their' (for eu), with no mutation (y bot 'their being'; y kymryt 'their taking' = to take them)
gyt: kyt (cyd) — together; in y gyt (a) 'together (with)' (y gyt ac wynt 'together with them')
ef: ef (ef) — 'he, him'; independent 3 sg. m. pronoun
deu: deu (dau) — two (m.); numeral, causes soft mutation of a following noun (y deu wrenhin 'the two kings')
un: un (un) — one; numeral/adjective (un dyrnaut 'one blow') · also 'same' (yn un ansawd 'in the same appearance'; yr un ford 'the same way') and the pronoun 'one (of them)' (Un a gyuodes 'one rose')
uam: mam (mam) — mother; noun f. (y mab a'y uam 'the boy and his mother'); soft-mutated (m>u) after the possessive y 'his'
guyrda: gwyrda (gwŷr da) — noblemen; gwyr 'men' + da 'good', plural noun (A wyrda 'O noblemen')
am: am — preposition 'about, around; concerning' (am y uynwgyl 'about his neck'; am dir a dayar 'about land')
hynny: hynny — 'that (thing)'; demonstrative pronoun, very frequent (a hynny 'and that')
mal: mal (fel) — as, like; conjunction (Ac mal y delei pob un 'and as each one came')
brenhin: brenhin (brenin) — king; noun m. (Brenhin corunawc wyf i 'I am a crowned king')
e: y — 'his', spelt e before a following consonant or in some spellings: e gwn 'his dogs', e weneb 'his face'; also the preposition 'to' in e uynet 'to go' · also 'her', with h- before a vowel (e hymlit hi 'to pursue her'); the verbal particle y (e deuthum i 'I came'); y of y wrth 'from' (e wrthaw 'from him'); and in e uynyd 'up', e ymdeith 'away'
ynteu: ynteu (yntau) — 'he, for his part'; conjunctive pronoun marking a change of speaker or actor (heb ynteu)
uerch: merch (merch) — daughter, girl; noun f., softened after a woman's name (Riannon uerch Heueyd 'Rhiannon daughter of Hefeydd')
r: 'r — the article yr contracted after a vowel, apostrophe half of a'r, y'r, o'r etc.: 'the'
neill: neill (naill) — one (of two); (o'r neill parth 'on the one side')
gueisson: gwas (gwas) — lads, servants; noun pl. (gueisson ieueinc 'young lads')
gwas: gwas (gwas) — lad, servant; noun m., base form (Y gwas 'the lad')
da: da — good; adjective, also 'goods, wealth' as a noun (treulaw dy da 'spending your wealth')
rwg: rwng (rhwng) — between; preposition, spelt rwg (Teirnon y rwg Pwyll a Riannon 'Teirnon between Pwyll and Rhiannon'); no mutation
sef: sef (sef) — it is (this), that is; presentative particle introducing an explanation or answer
ymlad: ymlad (ymladd) — to fight; verbal noun (yn herwyd ymlad a frouedigaeth y gorff)
rwng: rwng (rhwng) — between; preposition, base uninflected form
uei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'might be', soft-mutated after a (a uei uwy no hynny)
uwyaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'most', soft-mutated (after pei, as after modern po) (A ffei uwyaf y lladei 'the more he would strike') · also soft after a feminine noun, adjective 'greatest, most' (y wreic uwyaf a garaf 'the woman I love most', mwyaf)
ual: ual (fel) — as, like; conjunction/preposition (ual hynn 'like this')
yuelly: yuelly (felly) — thus, so, in that way; adverb, the particle y fused with uelly (a chyt kerych di uot yuelly 'though you wish it to be so'; Ac yuelly y gwnaethpwyt 'and so it was done'); no mutation
wynt: wynt (hwynt) — they, them; 3 pl. pronoun (un lliw ac wynt 'the same colour as them') · also Wynt, Gwent, in the name Wynt Ys Coet 'Gwent Is Coed', a region of south-east Wales
welynt: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 pl. imperfect 'they saw', soft-mutated after a (wynt a welynt 'they saw'; yny welynt 'until they saw')
teir: tair (tair) — three; numeral, feminine form teir (mab teir blwyd 'a boy of three years'); no mutation
dec: tec (teg) — fair, pleasing; adjective (yn dec 'fairly'); soft-mutated (t>d) after predicative yn
dyuot: dyuot (dyfod) — to come; verbal noun (a dyuot y Lynn Cuch 'and coming to Glyn Cuch')
kyrchu: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, head towards; verbal noun (Kyrchu y llys a oruc ynteu)
parth: parth (parth) — towards, side, direction; noun m./preposition (parth a'y lys 'towards his court')
attunt: at (at) + wynt — 'to them'; conjugated preposition, 3 pl. (a doeth attunt 'came to them'); no mutation
cherdet: kerdet (cerdded) — to walk, go; verbal noun, spirant-mutated after a (a cherdet yn ol y cwn 'and going after the hounds') · also the noun 'pace, gait', spirant-mutated after y 'her' (y cherdet hitheu 'her pace')
ganthunt: gan — conjugated preposition 'with them' (ni bu newydach ganthunt 'it was no more novel to them')
hol: ol (ôl) — track, trace; noun m., with h- after y 'her' (yn y hol 'after her', literally 'in her track')
mi: mi — 1 sg. independent/emphatic pronoun 'I' (mi a wnn 'I know')
welaf: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 1 sg. present 'I see', soft-mutated after a (mi a welaf 'I see')
racco: racco (acw) — yonder; adverb after a noun (yr unbennes racco 'the lady yonder')
heb: heb — (1) 'said' (heb ef 'said he'), a defective verb used only for tagging speech; (2) 'without' + verbal noun (heb hanbwyllaw 'without troubling') · (3) 'past, beside' in heb law (heb law yr orssed 'past the mound'); see hebdaw
tir: tir (tir) — land, territory; noun m. (dylyedauc tir a dayar 'a lord of land and earth')
wyr: gwyr (gwŷr) — men; noun pl., soft-mutated after yn (yn wyr ymi 'as men to me') · also soft after o 'of' (o wyr 'of men') and in address (A wyr 'O men') · also soft after y 'to' (y wyr Dyuet 'to the men of Dyfed') and y 'his' (y wyr 'his men')
wiscaw: gwiscaw (gwisgo) — to dress, clothe; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y wiscaw eurwisc)
mynet: mynet (mynd) — to go; verbal noun (amser mynet y uwyta 'time to go to eat')
edrych: edrych (edrych) — to look; verbal noun (edrych ar y carw 'to look at the stag')
pa: pa (pa) — what, which; interrogative adjective, triggers soft mutation of the following noun
uedwl: medwl (meddwl) — mind, thought; noun m., soft-mutated after y 'his' (yn y uedwl)
yw: bot (bod) — to be; present 3 sg. copula 'is', used in equative sentences (Sef yw hwnnw, Hafgan)
gwyr: gwr (gŵr) — men; noun pl. (kymryt gwrogaeth y gwyr 'taking the homage of the men')
nessayssant: nessau (nesáu) — to draw near; 3 pl. preterite 'they drew near' (y deu urenhin a nessayssant)
gwedy: gwedy (gwedi) — after; preposition, the spelling beside guedy (A gwedy y bwyta kyntaf 'and after the first eating')
guelet: gwelet (gweld) — to see; verbal noun, gu for gw (A guelet a wnaeth 'and he saw')
diheu: diheu (diau) — certain, doubtless; adjective (ny bo diheu gantaw hynny 'who would not be sure of that'); no mutation
na: na — (1) negative particle in a subordinate clause, 'not' (na dywedy di); (2) 'neither/nor' in a series (na guas ystauell, na swydawc) · also negative imperative 'do not', with soft mutation (na ouyn di 'do not ask'; na yrrwch geu arnaf 'do not lay a lie on me'; na hawl ef 'do not claim him')
eiryoet: eiryoet (erioed) — ever; variant spelling of eiroet (o'r a welsei eiryoet 'of all he had ever seen')
noc: no (na) — than; spelling before a vowel (noc a uu 'than what was')
wy: wynt (hwynt) — they; 3 pl. pronoun, spelling variant (heb wy 'said they')
bali: bali — brocade, rich silk; noun m., a loanword from Old French paile (eurwisc o bali 'a gold garment of brocade')
arnunt: ar — conjugated preposition 'on them' (Sef lliw oed arnunt 'this was the colour that was on them')
rac: rac (rhag) — before, lest, to prevent, for fear of; preposition (dyro ui idaw rac anglot yt 'give me to him to spare you dishonour')
rei: rei (rhai) — some, some people; pronoun (rei o'r maes hwnn 'some of this field')
ereill: arall (arall) — other; plural ereill, the plural form of the adjective (y chwedleu ereill 'the other tales'); modern eraill
no: no (na) — than, comparative particle (no gyrru 'than driving'; no chyuedach)
uynyd: mynyd (mynydd) — mountain, upward; noun m. used adverbially 'upward', soft-mutated after y (a gyuodes y uynyd 'rose up')
arwyd: arwyd (arwydd) — sign, signal; noun m. (bit hynny yn arwyd 'let that be the signal')
ymdidan: ymdidan (ymddiddan) — conversation, to converse; noun/verbal noun, base form (dechreu ymdidan a wnaeth ef)
bwrw: bwrw (bwrw) — to throw, cast off; verbal noun (bwrw y bratteu 'casting off the rags')
allan: allan — out, forth; adverb ('o hynny allan' 'from then on')
wnaethont: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 pl. preterite 'they did', soft-mutated after a (the 'verbal noun + a wnaethont' auxiliary construction: Bwyta a chyuedach a wnaethont 'they ate and feasted')
wynteu: wynt (hwynt) — they, for their part; conjunctive 3 pl. pronoun (Wynteu hagen ni wybuyssynt)
guell: guell (gwell) — better; comparative adjective, in kyuarch guell 'greet' (literally 'ask better')
lle: lle (lle) — place; noun m., base unmutated form
yniuer: niuer (nifer) — company, host; noun m. with prosthetic y- (yr yniuer y buam doe 'the company that we were yesterday')
hynn: hynn (hyn) — 'this'; demonstrative, substantive use in ual hynn 'like this, thus' · also adjective 'this' after its noun (seith cantref hynn 'these seven cantrefs')
phwy: pwy (pwy) — who; interrogative pronoun (A phwy bynnac a dywot geu arnat 'and whoever said a lie of you'); spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and'
yssyd: bot (bod) — to be; relative present 'is, who/that is' (sydd) (Gwr yssyd gyuerbyn; pa amgen uedwl yssyd yndaw)
pennaf: penn (pen) — head, chief; superlative pennaf 'chief, principal' (Pennaf neges 'the chief errand')
arglwyd: arglwyd (arglwydd) — lord; noun m., term of address
mae: bot (bod) — to be; irregular present 3 sg. 'is, there is' (y mae arnat o anryded) · also interrogative 'where is?' (Mae yr yniuer …? 'where is the company …?')
ymma: ymma (yma) — here; adverb, spelling with mm (yssyd ymma 'is here')
beth: beth — what; interrogative pronoun (beth amgen 'what else?', beth a wnaf 'what shall I do?')
negessawl: negessawl — having an errand, on an errand; adjective, neges 'errand' + -awl (Negessawl wyf wrthyt 'I have an errand to you')
wrthyt: wrth (wrth) + ti — conjugated preposition 'to/at you' (Dywedaf wrthyt; chadw kywirdeb wrthyt titheu)
onyt: onyt (onid) — unless; conjunction (onyt ti a'm gwrthyt 'unless (it be) you (who) reject me')
neges: neges (neges) — errand, business; noun f. (yd oed neges idi 'she had an errand'; Pennaf neges 'the chief errand')
geif: caffael (cael) — to get; 3 sg. present 'will get', soft-mutated (c>g) after a (Ef a geif hynny 'he will get that')
ryw: ryw (rhyw) — some, some kind of; before its noun (ryw ystyr hut 'some meaning of magic')
thidy: tidy (tydi) — you (sg.), emphatic pronoun, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A thidy 'and you')
erchi: erchi (erchi) — to ask, request, bid; verbal noun (y erchi it 'to ask of you')
doeth: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 sg. preterite 'came' (a doeth 'and came')
os: os (os) — if; conjunction of a real condition (os hynny a uynny 'if that is what you want')
genhyt: gan — conjugated preposition 'with you' (2 sg.), a variant spelling of gennyt (a'r got honn genhyt 'and this bag with you')
bydynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. habitual imperfect 'they were (being), they used to be', beside oedynt (ual y bydynt yn eisted 'as they were sitting')
ie: ie — yes; particle of assent, taking up what was just said
ninheu: ni (ni) — we, for our part; conjunctive 1 pl. pronoun (a gaussam ninheu)
atteb: atteb (ateb) — answer, reply; noun m. (yr un atteb 'the same answer'); no mutation (vowel)
aeth: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. preterite 'went' (a'y vreic a aeth attaw 'and his wife went to him')
minheu: minheu (minnau) — I for my part; conjunctive 1 sg. pronoun, beside innheu (Minheu a baraf 'and I for my part will cause')
af: mynet (mynd) — to go; 1 sg. present/future 'I go, I will go' (a af 'will go')
llawen: llawen (llawen) — glad, gladly; adjective, base form (yn llawen)
uuwyt: bot (bod) — to be; impersonal preterite 'it was (been)' (llawen uuwyt wrthaw 'he was welcomed gladly', literally 'glad it was to him'), soft-mutated (b>u) after the fronted predicate llawen
wrthaw: wrth (wrth) + ef — conjugated preposition 'to/at him' (a dywedut ual hynn wrthaw) · also in y wrthaw, e wrthaw 'from him, away from him'
dygyuor: dygyuor (dygyfor) — to muster, rally (a hunt); verbal noun (dechreu dygyuor yr hela 'beginning to muster the hunt') · also noun 'muster, gathering' (Dygyuor y wlat a doeth attunt 'the muster of the land came to them')
mawr: mawr (mawr) — big, great; adjective (uarch erchlas mawr 'a big dapple-grey horse')
uu: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. preterite 'was' (bu), soft-mutated after a (tirionwch... a uu y ryngthunt)
nos: nos (nos) — night; noun f. (y nos honno 'that night')
trannoeth: trannoeth (trannoeth) — the next day; noun/adverb, base form
kymryt: kymryt (cymryd) — to take, receive; verbal noun (iawn yw gymryt; kymryt gwrogaeth)
kynghor: kynghor (cyngor) — counsel, advice; noun m., base form (Kynghor yw hynny 'that is counsel'; gan gynghor 'by the counsel')
rodi: rodi (rhoi) — to give, put; verbal noun, base form
prif: prif (prif) — chief, main; adjective (prif lys idaw 'his chief court')
teccaf: tec (teg) — fair, pretty; superlative 'fairest' (yr ardurn teccaf a welsei neb)
byt: byt (byd) — world; noun m. (o helgwn y byt 'of the hunting dogs of the world')
gwneuthur: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; verbal noun/infinitive, also used as the periphrastic auxiliary 'do' (a wneuthum itt 'that I did to you')
gyscu: kyscu (cysgu) — to sleep; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y (y gyscu 'to sleep')
genti: gan (gan) — 'with her'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. f., spelt genti (a chanawon genti 'and whelps with her'); no mutation
odyno: odyno (oddi yno) — from there, thence; adverb, o 'from' + yno 'there' (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there')
yniueroed: niuer (nifer) — host, company; plural niueroed with a prosthetic y- (teulu ac yniueroed)
niuer: niuer (nifer) — host, company, number; noun m. (a'r niuer hardaf a chyweiraf)
yny: yny (hyd oni) — until; so that; conjunction, with a vivid present (yny hyllt, yny dyrr, yny uyd) or the subjunctive for a future goal (yny delych) · also in Ac ar yny llyma, a slip for ar hynny 'thereupon', kept as written (the Red Book has ar hynny) (Ac ar yny, llyma y teulu 'and thereupon, behold the warband')
doethant: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 pl. preterite 'they came' (Y'r llys y doethant 'to the court they came')
hyt: hyt (hyd) — as far as, until; preposition/conjunction (hyt ym penn y ulwydyn 'until the year's end'; hyt na bo 'so that there be not') · also ar hyt 'along' (ar hyt y prifford 'along the highway') · also 'as far as, so far as, as much as, to the extent that' with the subjunctive (hyt y mynnych 'as much as you wish'; hyt y gallwyf y gaffael 'as far as I can get it'); hyt oet y wled 'until the time of the feast'
dechreu: dechreu (dechrau) — to begin; verbal noun (dechreu dygyuor 'beginning to muster') · also the noun 'beginning' (ar dechreu kyuedach 'at the start of the carousing')
wled: gwled (gwledd) — feast, banquet; noun f., soft-mutated after the article y as a feminine noun (y wled 'the feast'; y wled honno 'that feast')
eistedyssant: eisted (eistedd) — to sit; 3 pl. preterite in -yssant 'they sat', beside eistedyssont (ual yd eistedyssant 'as they sat')
arall: arall — other, another; adjective (yr erchwys arall 'the other pack') · also pronoun 'another (woman)' (heb arall 'said another')
nyt: ny (nid) — negative particle 'not, it is not', spelling before a vowel or in emphasis (nyt teilygdawt)
ty: ty (tŷ) — house; noun m. (yn y ty yd oed cassec 'in the house was a mare'); no mutation
namyn: namyn (namyn) — except, but; conjunction (namyn ti 'but you')
ny: ny (ni/nid) — negative particle 'not', base form before a consonant with soft mutation · also spirant mutation of c, p, t (ny chewch 'you will not get'; ny thygyawd 'it did not avail'); soft mutation of g (ny wybydei 'knew not')
gyuedach: kyuedach (cyfeddach) — carousing; noun m., soft-mutated after possessive y 'his' (a'y gyuedach 'and his carousing')
wnaethant: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 pl. preterite 'they did', soft-mutated after a (eisted a wnaethant)
phan: pan (pan) — when; spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A phan doeth yno)
uot: bot (bod) — to be; verbal noun, soft-mutated after a (ef a eill uot yn ediuar gennyf) · also soft as the complement of a verb (a dylyei uot 'that ought to be')
well: gwell (gwell) — better; comparative of da 'good', soft-mutated as the object of kyuarch (ny chyuarchaf i well it 'I do not greet you')
udunt: y (i) + wynt — conjugated preposition 'to them' (Amser a doeth udunt e uynet e gyscu)
hun: hun (hun) — self, own; also 'sleep' as a separate noun by context (e hunan/e hun 'himself'; kymryt hun 'to take sleep')
kyuedach: kyuedach (cyfeddach) — carousing, a drinking-feast; noun m., base form (ar dechreu kyuedach 'at the start of the carousing')
aethant: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 pl. preterite 'they went' (yd aethant 'they went')
gan: gan (gan) — with, by; preposition, softening the next word; possession is 'with' a person or thing (oed gan y march 'the horse had', literally 'was with the horse'); y gan 'from' (y gan y uarch 'from his horse'); base of gennyf, ganthaw, genthi etc. · also 'from', without y (ny chaffei namyn yr un atteb gan y gwraged 'she would get only the same answer from the women'; yny gigleu gan lawer 'until he heard from many')
thrannoeth: trannoeth (trannoeth) — the next day; noun/adverb, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A thrannoeth) · also spirant-mutated after no 'than' (no thrannoeth 'than the next day')
kyuodi: kyuodi (cyfodi) — to rise, get up; verbal noun (kyuodi a oruc 'he rose')
orugant: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 pl. preterite 'they did' (a orugant), older form beside wnaethant
pawb: pawb (pawb) — everyone; pronoun (pawb a'y dyly 'everyone owes it')
meirych: march (march) — horse; noun m., plural meirch, spelt meirych (y weisson y meirych 'the grooms of the horses'); no mutation
ym: yn (yn) — in; preposition, spelling variant before p/m/b (hyt ym Penn Llwyn Diarwya; ym perued) · also bot 1 pl. present 'we are' (yd ym y gyt 'we are together'; llibin yd ym pob blwydyn 'wretched that we are every year') · also 'my', a by-form of uy, in the oath ym kyffes y Duw 'by my confession to God' (the Red Book has ym kyffes i y Duw); the nasal mutation it brings is not written
pob: pob (pob) — each, every; adjective (pob un 'each one')
kyueir: kyueir (cyfair) — region, direction, part; noun m. (Sef kyueir o'y gyuoeth 'the part of his realm')
mor: mor (mor) — so, how; adverbial intensifier, triggers soft mutation (mor lwydannus)
gwr: gwr (gŵr) — man; noun m. (y gwr a oed yn lle Arawn 'the man who was in Arawn's place')
uchot: uchod (uchod) — above, up there; adverb, spelt uchot (yn y perllan uchot 'in the orchard above')
meirch: march (march) — horse; noun pl. (meirch a milgwn 'horses and greyhounds')
gouyn: gouyn (gofyn) — to ask; 2 sg. imperative 'ask!' (Gouyn ueithon y Wawl weicheu 'ask Gwawl for sureties')
wnaeth: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 sg. preterite 'he did', soft-mutated after a; auxiliary in 'verbal noun + a wnaeth' (dechreu ymdidan a wnaeth)
hyn: hyn (hyn) — these; demonstrative pronoun (y un o hyn 'any one of these'); no mutation
yna: yna (yna) — then; adverb (Yna y rodes Arawn y furuf)
dy: dy — 'your' (sg.); possessive pronoun, causes soft mutation (dy gerennyd 'your friendship') · also written for the affixed pronoun di 'you' after the presentative wely (Ac wely dy yna dy uab 'and there, behold, is your son')
ay: ay (ai) — is it?; interrogative particle (Ay uelly y mynny di 'is it so you wish?')
uorwyn: morwyn (morwyn) — maiden; noun f., soft-mutated in address (A uorwyn 'O maiden'), after the article (y uorwyn 'the maiden') and after o (o uorwyn 'of maiden')
kystal: kystal (cystal) — as good, as much; equative of da 'good' (kystal y doi y gof)
i: i — (1) emphatic independent pronoun 'I/me', echoing a verb or conjugated preposition (rof i, arnaf i); (2) spelling of y 'to' before a vowel or l/w (i waret); (3) spelling of y 'his' before some words (i wisc hela 'his hunting-dress') · (4) after ohonawch, probably the 2 pl. echoing pronoun chwi with its ch run into the ending (ohonawch i 'of you')
uwy: mwy (mwy) — more, greater; comparative, soft-mutated after a noun or a (ansyberwyt uwy; a uei uwy no hynny)
arnaf: ar — conjugated preposition 'on me' (arnaf i 'on me')
dan: dan (dan) — under; preposition (dan y coet 'under the wood')
wrth: wrth (wrth) — to, towards, according to; preposition, base form (dywedut... wrthaw)
clusteu: clust (clust) — ears; noun pl. (eu clusteu yn gochyon 'their ears red')
graf: craf (craff) — keen, sharp, intent; adjective, spelt graf (edrych ar y mab yn graf 'to look intently at the boy'); soft-mutated (c>g) after predicative yn
llad: llad (lladd) — to kill; verbal noun, base form (y'm llad i 'to kill me') · also llad glwm 'to tie a knot' (idiomatic, literally 'strike a knot'): llad glwm ar garryeu y got 'to tie a knot on the straps of the bag'
nat: na, nat (nad) — 'that … not'; negative conjunction of a subordinate clause, nat before a vowel (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there')
chwedyl: chwedl (chwedl) — tale, story, report, rumour; noun m. (yd aeth y chwedyl 'the report went'; am y chwedyl 'about the story'); no mutation
at: at — preposition 'to, towards' (at y cwn 'to the dogs')
dywedut: dywedut (dweud) — to say, speak; verbal noun/infinitive
ohonunt: o (o) + wynt — 'of them, from them'; conjugated preposition, 3 pl. (kyscu a wnaeth pawb ohonunt 'every one of them slept'); no mutation
wnaethpwyt: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; impersonal preterite 'was done', soft-mutated after a (a wnaethpwyt 'was done'), -pwyt as the impersonal ending
wneuthur: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; verbal noun (y wneuthur kynnadeu at Pwyll 'to send envoys to Pwyll', literally 'to make messengers'); soft-mutated (gw>w) after the preposition y 'to'
thi: ti (ti) — you; 2 sg. pronoun, spirant-mutated after a 'and, with' (gyt a thi 'together with you')
dioer: dioer — assuredly, indeed; an oath, a worn-down Duw a wyr 'God knows'
uy: uy (fy) — my; possessive pronoun, triggers nasal mutation (uy anryded; uy nghyffes; uy gherennyd)
gystal: kystal (cystal) — as good; adjective, soft-mutated after ny (ny bu gystal dy wybot 'your judgement was never so good')
gyn: kyn (cyn) — as, equative particle before an adjective (kyn hygaret 'as lovable', spelt gyn after ny)
wely: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 2 sg. present 'you will see', soft-mutated after a (ti a wely a wneuthum i yrot ti) · also in the presentative (a) wely di 'do you see?' = 'behold' (Ac wely dy yna dy uab 'and there, behold, is your son'; the Red Book has weldy), softened after the question particle a, which is absorbed
dangos: dangos (dangos) — to show, make known; verbal noun (y erchi … dangos 'to bid (them) show themselves')
oes: bot (bod) — to be; present 3 sg. existential 'there is' (Nit oes yndi nep)
it: itt (iti) — to you; 2 sg. conjugated preposition, spelling variant with single t (achos it heuyt)
bot: bot (bod) — to be; verbal noun (hyt na bo... uot 'so that there be...')
adaw: adaw (gadael) — to leave; verbal noun, a form without g- (A dyuot cof idaw adaw y drws yn agoret 'and he remembered leaving the door open'); no mutation
ouyn: ofyn (ofn) — fear; noun m., u for the v-sound (nyt oes arnaf i ouyn 'I have no fear', literally 'there is no fear on me') · also 3 sg. present of gouyn (gofyn) 'asks', with g lost by soft mutation after a (ef a ouyn yt 'he will ask you'); a different word from ofyn 'fear' · also 2 sg. imperative of gouyn (gofyn) 'ask', g lost by soft mutation after na (na ouyn di yni y mab 'do not ask us for the boy')
paham: paham (pam) — why?; interrogative adverb, pa + am 'for what'
eueyd: Heueyd (Hefeydd) — proper name, Rhiannon's father; spelt Eueyd without the h- (Eueyd Hen 'Heueyd the Old')
hir: hir (hir) — long; adjective (yn hir 'for a long time')
darpar: darpar (darpar) — preparation, provision; noun m. (y wled a'r darpar 'the feast and the preparation')
pha: pa (pa) — what, which; interrogative, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a pha wlat 'and what land')
achaws: achaws (achos) — cause, reason; noun m. ('Pa achaws' 'what reason, why')
pei: pei (pe) — if; conjunction of an unreal or hypothetical condition, with the imperfect subjunctive (pei ys guelwn 'if I saw it'); in pei … pellaf it works like modern po 'the more … the farther'; after a 'and' written phei, ffei, fei
ys: ys (ys) — 'it is'; copula particle introducing a predicate, esp. in time expressions (ys blwydyn 'it is a year' = for a year) · also the infixed 3 sg. object 's 'it' after pei (pei ys guelwn 'if I saw it') · also 'below, under', is, in the name Wynt Ys Coet 'Gwent Is Coed'
cwbyl: cwbl (cwbl) — whole, complete; adjective/noun m., spelt cwbyl (kynn dyuot cwbyl o'r oet 'before the whole of the term came'); no mutation
geueis: caffael (cael) — to get; 1 sg. preterite 'I got' (a geueis i yn gedymdeith 'that I got as a companion')
duc: dwyn (dwyn) — to bring, carry, take; 3 sg. preterite 'took' (Ruthyr a duc 'he made a rush', literally 'a rush he took'); no mutation shown after a (d for dd)
neb: neb (neb) — anyone; pronoun, used with a positive sense in relative/superlative clauses (o'r a welsei neb 'that anyone had seen') · also 'anyone' under a negative = 'no one' (ny thykya y neb ymlit 'it avails no one to pursue') · also in y neb a 'the one who/to whom' (y neb a dylyer y kymryt y ganthaw 'the one from whom one ought to take it')
honn: hon (hon) — 'this' (f.); variant spelling of hon (no'r ulwydyn honn 'than this year')
genthi: gan — conjugated preposition 'from her' (3 sg. f.) (genthi hi 'from her') · also 'with her' (kyscu genthi 'to sleep with her')
kyn: kyn (cyn) — before; with a verbal noun (kyn uy rodi 'before my being given') · also the equative particle 'as', softening the adjective (kyn debycket a'r mab 'as like as the boy')
uod: bod (bodd) — pleasure, will, liking; noun m., soft-mutated (b>u) after possessive y 'his' (wrth y uod 'according to his pleasure')
yt: y 'to' — conjugated preposition, 2 sg. 'to you', modern iti, spelt yt beside itt and itti (Duw a ro da yt 'may God give you good'; rac anglot yt 'for fear of dishonour to you'; ef a ouyn yt 'he will ask you'; derw yt 'it has befallen you')
chyt: kyt (cyd) — although; spirant-mutated after a (a chyt archo ef 'and though he ask')
bo: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may be' (Vrth ual y bo dy anryded 'according as your rank may be')
gennyt: gan — conjugated preposition 'with you' (sg.) (ny bu gyn hawsset gennyt titheu 'it was never so easy for you')
guare: gware (chwarae) — to play, play with; verbal noun, spelt guare (guare a'r got 'to play with the bag'; guare broch yg got 'the game of badger in the bag')
ni: ni — (1) 1 pl. pronoun 'we/us' (yd ymdidanyssam ni); (2) negative particle, spelling variant of ny before some verbs (ni ladaf, ni bu)
eill: gallu (gallu) — to be able; 3 sg. present, irregular form 'may, can' (ef a eill uot 'it may be')
menegi: menegi (mynegi) — to tell, relate; verbal noun (menegi y holl gyfranc a wnaeth idi)
uynet: mynet (mynd) — to go; verbal noun, soft-mutated after e/y (e uynet e gyscu 'to go to sleep')
nys: ny + 's — negative particle ny with infixed 3 sg. object pronoun 's 'it': 'not it' (nys attygy 'you will not withdraw it') · also 'him, her' (nys mynnaf 'I do not want him')
anuon: anuon (anfon) — to send; verbal noun ('anuon o pop un y gilid' 'each one sending to the other')
etwa: etwa (eto) — yet, still; adverb (nys mynnaf etwa 'I do not want him yet')
ol: ol (ôl) — track, trace; noun m. (yn ol y cwn 'after the hounds'; yn y ol 'in its track')
ewch: mynet (mynd) — to go; 2 pl. imperative 'go' (nac ewch bellach hynny 'do not go any further'); no mutation
march: march (march) — horse; noun m., base form (y march 'the horse')
iach: iach (iach) — healthy, well; adjective (yn iach 'in health')
uo: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may be', soft-mutated after phan 'when' (phan uo ef ar perued 'when he is in the middle of')
wyneb: gwyneb (wyneb) — face; noun m., base unmutated form
ydaw: y (i) + ef — 'to him'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m., spelt ydaw (heb gynnhic ydaw 'without offering to him'); no mutation
wr: gwr (gŵr) — man; noun m., soft-mutated as object (ansyberwyt uwy ar wr) · also soft after y 'to' (y wr 'to a man, to a husband')
m: 'm — infixed/proclitic pronoun, apostrophe half of a'm, y'm, o'm etc.: 'my' (possessive, triggers soft mutation) or 'me' (object) · with h- before a following vowel (o'm hanwod 'against my will'); as 'my' before a verbal noun it may stand for that noun's object (a'm rodi 'and my giving' = and giving me); as 'me' after a relative (a'm gwrthyt 'who rejects me')
inheu: inheu (innau) — I/mine, for my part; conjunctive 1 sg. pronoun marking contrast (a'm kyuoeth inheu 'my realm, mine')
gwnaethpwyt: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; impersonal preterite 'was done' (Ac yuelly y gwnaethpwyt 'and so it was done'), -pwyt; no mutation after the particle y
lad: lladd (lladd) — to kill; verbal noun (am lad o honaf uu hun uy mab 'for my killing of my own son'); soft-mutated (ll>l) after the preposition am
diuetha: diuetha (difetha) — to destroy; verbal noun (arnei e hun diuetha y mab 'against her that she herself destroyed the boy'; a'e diuetha 'and destroying him'); no mutation
wnaf: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 1 sg. present/future 'I will do', soft-mutated after a (mi a wnaf hynny) · also 'I will see to it, bring it about that' (mi a wnaf na chaffo ef uiui uyth 'I will see that he never gets me'); auxiliary (Y gymryt a wnaf 'I will take it')
mynho: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may wish' (Aet a'y mynho 'let him go who may wish it'), -o; no mutation
garedic: karedic (caredig) — beloved; adjective (yn llwydannus garedic gan y gyuoeth 'prosperously, beloved by his realm'); soft-mutated (k>g) as a second adjective after yn llwydannus, as if in one phrase with it
gynghor: kynghor (cyngor) — counsel, advice, will; noun m., soft-mutated after possessive y 'his' (wrth y gynghor ef 'by his counsel'; gan gynghor 'by the counsel of') · also soft as the object of a verb (mi a wnn gynghor da 'I know good counsel')
cael: caffael (cael) — to get, suffer, receive; verbal noun, cael beside caffael (ouyn cael kymriw 'fear of getting injury')
chael: caffael (cael) — to get, find; verbal noun (A chael yn y uedwl 'and finding in his mind'); spirant-mutated (c>ch) after a 'and'
iawn: iawn — right, proper, correct; adjective/predicate (iawn yw gymryt 'it is right to receive')
gymryt: kymryt (cymryd) — to take, receive; verbal noun, soft-mutated after i/y (iawn yw gymryt 'it is right to receive')
yneuad: neuad (neuadd) — hall; noun f., spelt with prothetic y- (Y'r yneuad yd aethont 'into the hall they went'); no mutation
uwyta: bwyta (bwyta) — to eat; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (mynet y uwyta 'go to eat')
wastat: gwastat (gwastad) — constant, level; adjective, soft-mutated after yn (yn ryuelu arnaf yn wastat 'warring on me constantly')
medylyaw: medylyaw (meddwl/myfyrio) — to think, ponder; verbal noun (medylyaw a wnaeth yn hir)
unben: unben (unben) — chieftain, lord; noun m., un 'one' + penn 'head'; vocative form of address
gawssei: caffael (cael) — to get; 3 sg. pluperfect 'he had got' (y douot a gawssei 'the doubt he had got'), -ssei; soft-mutated (c>g) after the relative a
gam: cam (cam) — wrong; noun m., soft-mutated as object (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also cam 'step, pace', noun m., soft after y 'his, its' (bei ar y gam 'if it were at its step' = at a walk)
nit: nyt (nid) — negative particle 'not, there is not', spelling before a vowel (Nit oes; Nit yttoydwn)
wyt: bot (bod) — to be; 2 sg. present 'you are' (pwy wyt ti 'who are you')
auory: auory (yfory) — tomorrow; adverb (o'r dyd auory 'from the day tomorrow')
dalo: talu (talu) — to pay, repay; 3 sg. present subjunctive, soft-mutated after a (Duw a dalo itt 'may God repay you')
heuyt: heuyt (hefyd) — also, either; adverb (Ni wydwn achos it heuyt 'I did not know a reason for you either')
rodaf: rodi (rhoi) — to give, put; 1 sg. present/future 'I will give/put' (mi a'th rodaf di)
hediw: heddiw (heddiw) — today; adverb (na ommed neb hediw 'let no one be refused today')
uwrw: bwrw (bwrw) — to throw, cast; verbal noun, soft-mutated as possessed object, 'its throwing' = throwing it (yn y uwrw y'r llawr)
erbyn: erbyn (erbyn) — (1) against, by (a time) (erbyn hanner dyd 'by midday'); (2) 'to meet' (yn y erbyn 'to meet him')
bu: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. preterite 'was' (a uu 'was'; Llawen uu 'glad was')
oreu: goreu (gorau) — best; superlative of da 'good', softened after a feminine noun (y neges oreu 'the best errand')
eithyr: eithyr (eithr) — except; conjunction/preposition (eithyr gadu 'except to leave')
byd: bot (bod) — to be; used two ways: 3 sg. future 'will be' (uyd elsewhere) and, with y-, the vivid present ual y byd 'as he is' · also 2 sg. imperative 'be!' (byd ditheu a'r got honn genhyt 'you be there with this bag')
ganthaw: gan — conjugated preposition 'with him' (y bu digrif ganthaw 'it was pleasant with him') · also in y ganthaw 'from him' (kymer gedernit y ganthaw 'take a pledge from him')
diolwch: diolwch (diolch) — to thank; verbal noun/imperative-like (diolwch y'r gwr 'thank the man') · also noun 'thanks, gratitude' (diolwch ac elwissen 'thanks and alms-merit')
hyny: hynny (hynny) — that; demonstrative pronoun, spelt hyny with one n, kept as written (the Red Book has hynny) (arnaw hyny 'on him, that')
diruawr: diruawr (dirfawr) — immense, vast, exceeding; adjective (diruawr llywenyd 'immense joy'); no mutation
gymerth: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; 3 sg. preterite 'took', soft-mutated after a (Y march a gymerth 'he took the horse'; a gymerth rygyng 'took an amble')
tra: tra (tra) — while; conjunction (tra deweis wrthyt ti 'while I kept silent') · also (2) 'very', before an adjective with spirant mutation (tra chyuoethauc 'very mighty'); (3) 'while' with the verb sometimes soft-mutated (tra barhaud)
odyna: odyna (oddi yna, oddyna) — from there, then, after that; adverb, od 'from' + yna 'there' (Odyna treulaw y ulwydyn 'then spending the year')
ebolyon: ebawl (ebol) — foal; noun m., plural ebolyon (yr ebolyon 'the foals'); no mutation
dodet: dodi (dodi) — to put; impersonal 'has been put', after the perfective particle ry (ry dodet ymman 'has been put here') · also impersonal preterite 'was put, was laid' after the relative a (Sef penyt a dodet erni 'this is the penance that was laid on her'; Sef enw a dodet arnaw 'the name that was given him')
eil: eil (ail) — second; ordinal numeral (yr eil 'the second')
pan: pan (pan) — when; temporal conjunction with a past-time clause (pan doeth) · also interrogative 'from where, whence' (pan doy di? 'where do you come from?')
yti: y (i) + ti — conjugated preposition 'to you', variant spelling (pa furyf y caf i dy gerennyd di... yti)
ymi: y (i) + mi — conjugated preposition 'to me' (pa gyuarwyd a uyd ymi)
im: im (i mi) — to me; conjugated preposition, contracted spelling (Meuyl im 'shame to me')
th: 'th — infixed/proclitic pronoun, apostrophe half of a'th, i'th, dy'th etc.: 'your' (possessive) or 'you' (object)
wlat: gwlat (gwlad) — land, country; noun f., soft-mutated after the feminine article or possessive (y wlat; i'th wlat)
yno: yno (yno) — there; adverb (ac yno y bu y nos honno)
pwy: pwy (pwy) — who; interrogative pronoun (pwy wyt ti 'who are you')
wreic: gwreic (gwraig) — wife, woman; noun f., soft-mutated after a'y/possessive (ymdidan a'y wreic) · also soft after the article, as a feminine noun (y wreic 'the woman')
ony: ony (oni) — unless, until; conjunction ('no, unless …'), causes spirant mutation of c, p, t (ony chyuyt 'unless there rise') · also with soft mutation of g (ony wybydaf i 'if I do not find out')
dim: dim — anything, nothing; indefinite pronoun (ny russya dim ragot 'nothing will obstruct before you')
gwn: ci (ci) — dog; plural cwn, soft-mutated c > g after e 'his' (e gwn 'his dogs')
wnn: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; 1 sg. present 'I know', soft-mutated after a/ny, g dropped (mi a wnn; ny wnn i)
managaf: menegi (mynegi) — to tell, show; 1 sg. present/future 'I will tell' (Managaf)
hela: hela (hela) — to hunt; verbal noun (uynet y hela 'to go to hunt')
oedwn: bot (bod) — to be; 1 sg. imperfect 'I was' (yd oedwn inheu)
gelwit: galw (galw) — to call; 3 sg. impersonal imperfect 'he was called' (y gelwit Pwyll Penn Annwuyn)
geuyn: keuyn (cefn) — back; noun m., soft-mutated after 'y (a'y geuyn attei 'and his back to her')
arnaw: ar — conjugated preposition 'on him, on it' (llithiau dy erchwys dy hun arnaw 'feeding your own pack on it')
gwreic: gwreic (gwraig) — wife, woman; noun f., meaning as context decides (a'y wreic 'and his wife')
ot: ot (o + -t) — 'if' in the idiom ot gwnn 'if I know' = as far as I know, I trust
uawr: mawr (mawr) — great, big; adjective (grauanc uawr 'a great claw'); soft-mutated (m>u) after a feminine noun
chyrchu: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, head towards; verbal noun, spirant-mutated after a (a chyrchu y bordeu 'and making for the tables')
gerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — going, pace; verbal noun/noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y gerdet 'to go'), after vn 'same' (vn gerdet; why is not clear, kerdet being usually masculine), and in amgen urys gerdet 'other haste of pace' (cause unclear)
chwi: chwi (chi) — 'you' (pl.); pronoun (y'ch kynnal chwi 'to maintain you')
llyna: llyna (dyna) — there is, behold that; presentative particle, distal counterpart of llyma
arnam: ar (ar) + ni — 'on us'; conjugated preposition, 1 pl. (drwc arnam 'harm on us'); no mutation
idi: idi (iddi) — to her; 3 sg. f. conjugated form of y 'to' (menegi... a wnaeth idi)
mab: mab (mab) — son, boy; noun m. (mab a anet idaw 'a son was born to him'); no mutation (subject, fronted)
llawn: llawn (llawn) — full; adjective (a uyd llawn dy got ti uyth 'will your bag ever be full?')
buant: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. preterite 'they were' (Ny buant 'they were not')
ulwydyn: blwydyn (blwyddyn) — year; noun f., soft-mutated after y/the feminine article (hyt ym penn y ulwydyn) · also adverbial, 'a year' in time phrases, soft-mutated without the article (ulwydyn y heno 'a year from tonight'; ual yd eistedyssant ulwydyn o'r nos honno 'as they sat a year from that night'), the soft mutation being that of an adverbial accusative of time
chyn: kyn (cyn) — although, though; spirant-mutated after a (a chyn nyt ymdialwyf 'and though I do not avenge myself') · also the equative particle cyn 'as', spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a chyn ureisket oed a mab chweblwyd 'and as stout as a boy of six')
pedwyryd: pedwerydd (pedwerydd) — fourth; ordinal (pen y pedwyryd ulwydyn 'the end of the fourth year'); no mutation
peri: peri (peri) — to cause, make, have (something done); verbal noun, fronted before a wnaeth (Peri dwyn y gassec y mywn ty a wnaeth 'he had the mare brought into the house'); no mutation
kyuoeth: kyuoeth (cyfoeth) — realm, dominion; noun m. (a oed yn arglwyd... o'y gyuoeth)
pen: penn (pen) — head, end; noun m., spelling variant with single n (hyt ym pen y ulwydyn)
dewis: dewis (dewis) — choice; to choose; noun/verbal noun (caffwn dewis 'I could have choice')
ae: ae (ae) — either … or; correlative conjunction (ae a'e droet ae a throssawl 'either with his foot or with a staff'); no mutation
wneit: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; impersonal imperfect 'was being done' (o'r bedyd a wneit yna 'with the baptism that was then done'), -it; soft-mutated (gw>w) after the relative a
reit: reit (rhaid) — need, necessity; noun m./f. (reit ymi 'need to me' = 'I need')
hanuod: anuod (anfodd) — displeasure, unwillingness; noun m., with h-prefix after the contracted 'm 'my' (o'm hanuod 'against my will')
herwyd: herwyd (herwydd) — in respect of, according to; preposition (yn herwyd ymlad 'in respect of fighting')
ystauell: ystauell (ystafell) — room, chamber; noun f. (na guas ystauell 'no chamber-servant')
oll: oll (oll) — all, wholly; adverb/adjective intensifying a preceding noun (yr arueu oll 'all the armour')
barawt: parawt (parod) — ready; adjective, soft-mutated after predicative yn (yn barawt 'ready')
pheri: peri (peri) — to cause, command; verbal noun, spirant-mutated (p>ph) after a 'and' (a pheri dodi gostec 'and having a proclamation made')
gossot: gossot (gosod) — an onset, a setting-on, an attack; noun m. (ar y gossot kyntaf 'at the first onset')
uwyt: bwyt (bwyd) — food; noun m., soft-mutated after o (diwallaf o uwyt a llynn 'best supplied with food and drink')
ben: pen (pen) — head; noun m. (ar y ben 'on his head'); soft-mutated (p>b) after the possessive y 'his'
wedy: gwedy (gwedi) — after; preposition, spelt without g, as in modern wedi (wedy bwyta 'after the eating'); the loss of g is a variant spelling, there is no clear softening word
yg: yn (yn) — in; preposition, spelt yg before a g: the g is the written trace of the nasal mutation (yg gwyd = yng ngwyd 'in the presence of'; yg got = yng nghod 'in a bag', with c>ngh after yn 'in')
dwy: dwy (dwy) — two (f.); numeral, causes soft mutation of a following feminine noun (y dwy dyrnas 'the two kingdoms')
uyd: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. present/future 'is, will be' (byd), soft-mutated after a or a predicate (Dilesteir uyd dy hynt; yny uyd Hafgan)
hwy: hwy (hwy) — 'they, them'; independent 3 pl. pronoun (arnunt hwy 'over them') · also 'longer', comparative of hir (Ny bu hwy ganthunt no thrannoeth 'it was no longer with them than the next day')
llawr: llawr (llawr) — ground, floor; noun m., base form (y'r llawr 'to the ground')
tharaw: taraw (taro) — to strike; verbal noun (a tharaw y ureich 'and to strike off the arm'); spirant-mutated (t>th) after a 'and'
gantaw: gan (gan) — 'with him'; conjugated preposition, 3 sg. m., spelt gantaw (hyspys oed gantaw 'it was known to him'); no mutation
delw: delw (delw) — image, form, manner; noun f. (Pa delw 'in what manner')
cadarnhau: cadarnhau — to strengthen; verbal noun, from cadarn 'strong' (dechreu cadarnhau kedymdeithas 'the fellowship began to strengthen')
arueu: arueu (arfau) — arms, armour; noun pl. (yny dyrr yr arueu oll 'so that all the armour breaks')
goreu: goreu (gorau) — best; superlative of da 'good' (Goreu yw gennyf 'it is best with me' = I prefer)
welas: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 sg. preterite 'saw', soft-mutated after relative y (yny welas y llys a'r kyuanned)
